item.description: - Fixed CueNow disappearing when another application's menu bar item is changed in System Settings. ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude, and other applications now affect only their own icons. - Turning CueNow off in System Settings now hides only CueNow. Turning it back on restores it without quitting the app. - Preserves CueNow's existing menu bar position while moving it to a stable, app-owned menu bar identity.
